**Use for:** Conversion to neuro/tractmeasures and legacy group plots.

**Not for:** New analyses; use neuro/tractmeasures.

**BIDS:** no BIDS counterpart.

**Sharing:** Tier 2 (pseudonymised participant-level) by default.

**Apps:** Input to 2 Apps, output of 2 Apps.

Full record: https://github.com/brainlife/abcd-spec/blob/master/datatypes/neuro.tractprofile-deprecated.json

files.desc: Directory with one CSV of node-wise measures per tract.

identifying_risks: Rows keyed by subject and session codes
Values from rare conditions in small samples can single people out
governance.rationale: Tool 1 step 4: participant-level derived measures without direct identifiers.
sharing_cautions: Use coded subject IDs and drop dates
Release group summaries when per-participant rows are not needed
tier_conditions: Tier 1 once reduced to group statistics with no participant rows
Tier 4 if used as features for predicting cognitive or clinical states
